 staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

The breaker should be switched off and 
 disconnected out of its cell.
Disconnect the dc control voltage.
Complete tool of common keys and screw drivers.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes .
Brushes ,grease and air blower .
Digital multimeter .
Clean the breaker from any dust.
Check screw connections for tightness.
Close and open the breaker mechanically.

Check the manual charging and 
 discharging of the mechanism.

Check the connections of earthing system 
 .
Check the cable socket of the breaker.

Check pushbuttons, singnal lamps ,fuses 
 and auxiliarty relays.
Check for SF6 leakage.
Check the value of control voltage.

Check the charging and discharging of 
 the breaker electrically.

Check the operation of the breaker from 
 local in test position .

Check the operation of the breaker from 
 remote in test position .
Record the counter reading.

Introduction
